boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / UI icon design exploration.
Create an ORIGINAL professional FactorLab icon comparison sheet for a sector-allocation research learning app. This is a screening board of distinct candidate UI symbols, not a screenshot of an existing app.
Art direction combines rough handmade linocut / woodblock game emblems (ivory cut-paper symbols on imperfect black ink seals, muted dark violet backdrop) with the immediately readable geometry of simple financial line icons. Do not copy any specific skull, heart, tentacle, gun or human figure from the visual references. No gore, fantasy weapons, money rain, photorealism, 3D, gradients, neon, decorative scenery or UI screenshot buttons.
Canvas: high-resolution portrait approximately 1536x2048. Flat muted ink-violet background #211f30. Warm bone ivory #eee1b5 symbols, black #101012 ink badges, occasional restrained taupe detail only. Crisp intentional contours, generous internal negative space, subtle controlled edge wear; no thin hairline clutter. Every silhouette must remain recognizable as a small UI icon.
Layout: one beautifully typeset comparison board with a short header, exactly THREE equally wide columns and SIX evenly spaced rows = exactly 18 candidate icons. Generous consistent spacing. Icons in every cell have the same optical size (about 160 px tall), not giant decorative illustrations. Each cell has its short identifier below the icon, e.g. "01A". Each row has a small left-side English category label, separated from the icons. Nothing overlaps. Header typography is refined editorial sans serif, all labels perfectly legible.
Column A: "A / WOODCUT" — expressive cream silhouette on an irregular torn black stamp or seal, deliberately handcrafted chunky cuts, largest personality.
Column B: "B / LINE" — clean bone-ivory monoline pictograms directly on background with no badge, moderately bold strokes and simple explicit familiar financial symbols, very little wear.
Column C: "C / HYBRID" — original compact geometry with a few slightly chipped edges and a restrained incomplete ink seal, combines readability and tactile identity; different semantic composition from A and B.
The three alternatives in a row must use genuinely different silhouettes/compositions, not only recoloring the same symbol. Consistent visual grammar down each column. Do not add decorative icons beyond the specified 18. Bottom small caption exactly: "CONCEPT CANDIDATES / NOT FINAL SVG ASSETS".

Header exactly "FACTORLAB / ICON STUDY 01", subtitle "RESEARCH & DECISION".
Rows in this exact order:
01 RESEARCH: 01A a research dossier with a large observing lens cut into a torn rectangular black stamp; 01B a magnifying glass examining three unequal data bars; 01C an open ledger with a circular focal lens integrated into one page.
02 FACTORS: 02A four weighted vertical channels arranged as a carved testing instrument on a seal; 02B exactly four vertical sliders with knobs at distinct heights; 02C exactly four small input nodes converging into a central diamond. Avoid chemistry flask.
03 CYCLE: 03A a four-phase circular wheel engraved in rough round black ink; 03B a single smooth wave traversing an open circular clock ring; 03C two broad opposing curved arrows wrapping a small four-quadrant phase disk.
04 BACKTEST: 04A an hourglass with a tiny mixed up/down trajectory cut into the middle; 04B a returning arrow around a simple mixed up/down line chart; 04C a horizontal historical timeline with three marks and a returning bracket over it. Do not depict guaranteed rising performance.
05 ALLOCATION: 05A a compact balance beam holding two different weighted compartments; 05B a three-segment portfolio ring with one slightly separated segment; 05C three nested portfolio trays with different sized blocks arranged deliberately.
06 RISK: 06A a sturdy shield with a descending-then-level risk line carved through it; 06B an open shield outline containing a threshold gauge, no check mark; 06C a compact shield with an asymmetric inset notch and short drawdown line. No claim of guaranteed safety.
Under EACH icon print its correct unique ID, 01A 01B 01C through 06A 06B 06C.

Header exactly "FACTORLAB / ICON STUDY 02", subtitle "TOOLS & COMPANION".
Rows in this exact order:
07 JOURNAL: 07A a thick carved research notebook with bookmark on a torn stamp; 07B an open notebook with short pen; 07C a folded journal page with a small return-loop in the corner.
08 AI COACH: 08A an ORIGINAL small abstract white two-horn mask with two black oval eye holes and no mouth, inside a speech-shaped ink emblem, calm not sinister; 08B a simple speech bubble containing three connected nodes; 08C a geometric two-pointed mask silhouette integrated into the negative space of a compact conversation bubble. No robot trading, no check marks.
09 EVIDENCE: 09A two linked source sheets with a large visible link at their intersection; 09B three document-source nodes connected with two clean lines; 09C an open source folder with one clearly connected reference tab. Distinct from journal and research; source tracing, not correctness approval.
10 ACCOUNT: 10A a neutral simplified profile bust in a small rough arched seal; 10B a clean circular person outline; 10C a person silhouette with a small keyhole-shaped negative-space base. No skull.
11 LOCAL SAVE: 11A a carved folio descending into a local archive drawer; 11B a floppy disk silhouette with a small downward notch; 11C a compact archive box with a single page slot. LOCAL storage only, absolutely no cloud or cloud-sync imagery.
12 SETTINGS: 12A a stout irregular six-tooth carved gear around a round hub; 12B two horizontal slider controls with offset knobs; 12C a minimal geometric six-tooth gear with a single adjustment notch.
Under EACH icon print its correct unique ID, 07A 07B 07C through 12A 12B 12C.

Header exactly "FACTORLAB / ICON STUDY 03", subtitle "SECTORS & CASH".
Rows in this exact order:
13 SEMICONDUCTORS: 13A a bold etched chip die within a torn-square black stamp; 13B a square microchip with clear pins and tiny inner die; 13C a diamond-oriented silicon die nested within a partial pin frame.
14 ROBOTICS: 14A an industrial robot arm silhouette on a rough medallion; 14B a simple articulated robot arm with open gripper; 14C a compact gear with an integrated angular robot elbow. This means industrial automation, not a humanoid AI assistant.
15 MATERIALS: 15A a strong faceted crystal with three large faces on an ink seal; 15B a connected hexagonal materials lattice of three cells; 15C a single hexagonal crystal cross-section divided into three clear faces. Advanced materials, not medicine or DNA.
16 CLEAN ENERGY: 16A a wind turbine silhouette with a simple base inside a rough seal; 16B a solar panel with one small sun; 16C a battery-shaped block with one cutout lightning bolt and a single leaf-shaped negative space. Clear energy equipment, not an elaborate landscape.
17 AI INFRA: 17A a two-unit server rack with branching network cables etched on a stamp; 17B three server drawers connected to a short network base; 17C a central server block connected to two square endpoint nodes. Infrastructure, not the AI coach speech bubble.
18 CASH: 18A a compact coin stack in a carved pouch silhouette; 18B two stacked coins with a plain unmarked face; 18C a small wallet with a round coin tucked into its edge. No currency text, arrows, profits, jackpot or trading imagery.
Under EACH icon print its correct unique ID, 13A 13B 13C through 18A 18B 18C.

notes: Original visual concepts; no production UI replaced.
A: Woodcut; B: Line; C: Hybrid.
The five current top-level views are unchanged; factor/cycle/backtest rows are semantic categories, not new navigation destinations.
